papers.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

ai_summary.problem: 现有任务无关的JEPA世界模型通常在单一时间尺度或共享潜空间中进行多步预测与规划，难以应对需要跨时间尺度和抽象层级的长时程视觉规划问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出H-JEPA，一种端到端训练动作条件化JEPA层级的方法：每一层在自己的学习潜空间中预测更远的未来。规划采用自顶向下方式，顶层优化向目标的进展，其预测作为下层的子目标。结合逆动力学监督，方法可扩展到DROID真实机器人视频。
ai_summary.result: 在四个模拟导航与操作环境中，层级规划优于扁平JEPA；在Visual AntMaze上，三级层级将成功率从18%提升到73%，且规划计算量更少。在DROID真实机器人视频上，层级结构以更低规划计算量提升了离线规划保真度。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出端到端训练的层级动作条件化JEPA世界模型，通过时间抽象和更高层目标/子目标表示实现跨时间尺度的视觉规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了潜空间世界模型与层级规划的结合，为长时程决策和可扩展机器人学习提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: Meta FAIR / NYU（Yann LeCun等）

papers.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.

ai_summary.problem: MM-DiT在生成过程中会通过多模态注意力反复更新文本token，形成动态的上下文token，但这些token具体编码了什么信息、发挥什么作用尚不明确。
ai_summary.method: 训练一个轻量瓶颈网络，将MM-DiT中间层的上下文token映射到冻结大语言模型的输入空间，让LLM基于这些隐藏表示用自然语言回答关于生成图像的问题；并基于发现提出Contextual Alignment训练技术，显式强化上下文token中的视觉语义信息。
ai_summary.result: 上下文token在去噪早期就编码了生成场景的全局语义和提示未指定的属性，随后逐渐可读出更细粒度细节；即使输入空提示，仍能解码出图像特定信息；上下文表示越可读的生成结果越容易获得更高人类偏好分数，Contextual Alignment还能提升生成质量和分布覆盖。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过自然语言探针系统解读MM-DiT中的上下文token，并将其可读性同时作为可解释性窗口和生成模型改进的训练目标。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态扩散Transformer的内部动态提供了可解释性视角，并展示了利用生成模型内部表示提升生成质量与多样性的新路径。
ai_summary.org: 作者主要可能来自特拉维夫大学（Daniel Cohen-Or、Or Patashnik等），Hadar Averbuch-Elor可能来自康奈尔大学。

papers.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 现有LLM Agent记忆系统大多以与查询无关的方式构建记忆，导致不必要的预处理开销，并可能丢弃后续关键细节；近期运行时自适应方法又通常局限于特定操作或固定流程，难以灵活权衡性能、成本与延迟。
ai_summary.method: 提出MemPilot框架，通过强化学习优化多步LLM策略，在“从查询无关记忆中检索”与“将原始多模态历史委托给异构LLM/VLM进行查询特定整理”之间迭代选择；策略联合控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择和视觉访问，并使用按目标优势解耦与基于前缀的边际效用估计进行多目标优化和细粒度信用分配。
ai_summary.result: 在五个多模态Agent记忆基准上，MemPilot在不同优化偏好下取得了良好的性能—成本—延迟权衡，且偏好扫描得到的前沿优于现有权衡感知基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 将Agent多模态记忆整理建模为可按性能、成本、延迟偏好动态编排的多步RL决策问题，并引入目标解耦优势与前缀边际效用估计。
ai_summary.relevance: 为LLM Agent提供了一种更灵活、可控且高效的多模态记忆管理范式，有助于推动Agent在长期交互中平衡效果与计算开销。

papers.title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.

ai_summary.problem: 世界动作模型依赖摄像头输入进行通用机器人控制，但其共享视觉编码器容易受到对抗性扰动影响；现有攻击需要访问目标模型输出或针对动作策略优化，难以跨任务和跨架构迁移。
ai_summary.method: 提出 TAPDreamer，仅使用公开编码器构造固定的局部对抗补丁，无需查询目标策略。其核心洞察是补丁引起的注意力权重与 value 向量交互会将表示偏移广播到补丁范围之外，并在不同任务观测中保持稳定；方法利用一个源任务的六帧图像，最大化干净与打补丁编码器表示之间的全局 L1 距离。
ai_summary.result: 在闭环评估中，每个基准仅需一个冻结补丁、覆盖约 6.5% 输入，即可将 FastWAM 在 40 个 LIBERO 任务上的成功率从 97.7% 降至 0.0%，在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务上从 90.8% 降至 0.0%；随机补丁仍保持 81.5% 和 79.2%。同一补丁也使 DreamWAM 两种配置降至 2.1% 和 0.8%，使 Motus 降至 10.0%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出无需目标策略查询、可跨任务和动作架构迁移的世界动作模型对抗补丁攻击，并揭示共享视觉编码器表示偏移是攻击成功的关键。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明仅保护下游动作生成不足，世界动作模型防御必须保护共享视觉编码器免受持久局部扰动，对具身智能和世界模型安全具有重要意义。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Textual World Modeling through Structured Reasoning
papers.abstract: World models must predict how an environment evolves under sequences of actions, enabling agents to compare possible futures and reason about counterfactual actions before acting. Long-horizon prediction is commonly obtained by recursively applying a one-step transition model, but intermediate errors can compound over time. Multi-step dynamics models instead condition on a sequence of future actions and predict their consequences directly, but become harder to learn as horizon grows: the model must track interacting state changes across the trajectory, endpoint supervision provides weak credit assignment, and intermediate predictions can remain plausible while losing information needed for later states. We show that these challenges can be addressed by casting the internal evolution of a multi-step transition as structured reasoning over textual world states: reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of state tracking, a predictive-gain objective rewards the learned state for improving over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead, and intermediate predictive rewards supervise each state along the trajectory. Because these intermediate states are explicit textual representations of the world, they provide semantically meaningful targets that can be inspected, scored, and corrected during training. Across ScienceWorld, Jericho, and CEO-Bench, our approach achieves the strongest average long-horizon performance against recursive and non-recursive baselines that condition directly on raw history, with gains increasing at longer horizons. In a controlled counterfactual study, our model is also the only one with statistically significant sensitivity to future actions.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型需在动作序列下进行长时程预测，但递归单步模型会累积误差，多步动力学模型又随预测步长增加而难以学习，存在状态追踪负担重、信用分配弱、中间预测信息丢失等问题。
ai_summary.method: 该论文将多步转移的内部演化建模为对文本世界状态的结构化推理：在稀疏状态变化上进行推理以降低状态追踪负担，使用预测增益目标奖励能优于原始历史预测器的学习状态，并用中间预测奖励监督轨迹上的每个显式文本状态。
ai_summary.result: 在 ScienceWorld、Jericho 和 CEO-Bench 上，该方法在长时程平均性能上优于递归和非递归基线，且优势随预测时程增加而增大；在受控反事实研究中，也是唯一对未来动作具有统计显著敏感性的模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将长时程文本世界建模转化为结构化推理，并通过显式文本中间状态、预测增益目标和中间预测奖励实现可检查、可评分、可纠正的多步预测监督。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为基于大模型的Agent世界模型提供了更可靠的长时程预测与反事实推理能力，对规划、决策和具身智能中的未来推演具有直接意义。

papers.title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

ai_summary.problem: 现有医学VQA和3D影像基准多通过孤立图像、静态体积或无依据的报告式答案评估脑MRI，无法揭示纵向临床推理中证据链的失败。本文旨在评估视觉语言模型能否追踪纵向脑MRI解读所需的证据结构。
ai_summary.method: 提出BrainTRACE，一个基于报告的基准，包含来自1,778名纵向患者的7,273个VQA实例、7,299次MRI检查和约29k个共配准3D MRI序列体积。基准按五级临床推理和四类证据需求组织，支持标准VLM接口的渲染输入、3D证据条件，以及审计六步纵向证据链的分解病例推理轨道。
ai_summary.result: 对20种VLM配置的评估显示，当前系统能识别孤立视觉线索，但很少将其组合成有依据的纵向解读。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向纵向、多模态、体积脑MRI临床推理的基于报告证据链基准，并引入3D证据条件与分解式病例推理审计。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动医学视觉语言模型评估从静态图像问答走向可审计的纵向临床证据推理。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者机构信息

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.abstract: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.

ai_summary.problem: LLM 智能体在调度冻结的 VLA 策略时，文本记忆只能记录「做了什么」而无法记录「怎么做」；而演示视频因上下文长度限制难以直接使用——整段视频拖慢每一轮推理，固定关键帧又丢失决定抓取成败的接触细节。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RV-ICL（递归视频上下文学习），一种免训练方法：把一段演示视频按抓取、释放等子事件组织成层级结构（从全任务关键帧到阶段、时刻、短片段），并通过只读工具暴露给智能体。智能体规划前先读取粗粒度层级，执行中在某个步骤需要细节时重新进入层级，仅加载当前子目标对应的片段。
ai_summary.result: 每个任务仅需一段演示，在 RPent 基础上将 LIBERO-PRO 成功率从 92.6% 提升到 96.5%，LIBERO-Plus 从 86.7% 提升到 95.8%。
ai_summary.novelty: 把演示视频从「一次性塞入的提示」转变为智能体可递归检索、按需下钻的分层结构，实现免训练且在接触关键时刻按需加载细粒度视觉信息。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能体高效利用人类演示视频、突破长视频上下文瓶颈提供了新范式，对机器人操作与 Agent 记忆/工具调用设计有直接启发。
ai_summary.org: 未知（论文未提供作者机构信息）

papers.title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
papers.abstract: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.

ai_summary.problem: 喉咽癌T分期对个性化治疗至关重要，但现有CT辅助分期难以建模肿瘤侵犯的解剖结构关系，且影像报告与具体器官的细粒度跨模态对齐不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出解剖感知的多模态框架，首先构建解剖结构化器官图（AOG）来刻画原发灶与周围器官的侵犯模式，然后通过器官锚定跨模态对齐（OCA）让每个器官节点聚合报告中对应的文本证据，最后利用报告增强图精炼（REG）注入器官特异性侵犯线索，形成融合空间与文本证据的多模态器官图。
ai_summary.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在喉咽癌T分期预测上取得了优越性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新在于以器官图结构建模肿瘤侵犯模式，并实现器官级别的细粒度跨模态对齐与报告增强图精炼。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学多模态AI提供了结构感知与细粒度跨模态融合的新思路，可推广至其他需要影像与报告联合分析的肿瘤分期任务。

papers.title: Improving Diversity in LLM Short Story Generation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity. We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM, an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality. Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs.

ai_summary.problem: 大语言模型虽然能生成准确回答，但内容往往缺乏多样性，本文聚焦于创意短篇故事生成中的多样性不足问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 DivLM 后训练框架，先用创意写作语料继续预训练并通过权重残差恢复指令跟随能力，再使用自定义复合奖励进行强化学习，在保持回答质量的同时联合最大化体裁、语气、风格和命名实体等叙事维度的多样性。
ai_summary.result: 在两个 LLM 系列上的实验表明，DivLM 相比替代方法平均将多样性指标提升超过 9%，同时保持指令跟随、整体回答质量以及与人类输出的相似性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将创意写作继续预训练、权重残差指令恢复与面向多维叙事多样性的复合强化学习奖励相结合，形成专门提升故事生成多样性的后训练框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为提升 LLM 在创意写作中的多样性提供了可借鉴的后训练思路，有助于缓解生成内容同质化问题。

papers.title: SAFE-MR: Evidence Sufficiency Learning for Selective Multimodal Rumor Detection
papers.abstract: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image-text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim-evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态谣言检测依赖检索证据，但相关证据不一定充分；证据缺失、重复报道或未解决矛盾会导致模型在支持不足时仍给出高置信预测。
ai_summary.method: 提出SAFE-MR框架，将声明真实性判断与证据充分性判断分离；把图文帖子分解为可验证声明，构建关系感知的声明-证据图，并基于来源可信度与上下文兼容性聚合证据；使用独立真实性和充分性预测头支持选择性预测，并通过证据干预训练增强对无关证据的稳定性和对证据移除的敏感性。

papers.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
papers.abstract: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.

ai_summary.problem: 现有受临床工作流启发的医疗多模态多智能体框架存在冗余通信拓扑，导致交互模式僵化且计算开销过大，影响医学VQA的推理效率和准确性。
ai_summary.method: 该论文提出MedPrune，将诊断过程建模为异构通信图，节点表示不同科室的专科智能体，边表示科室内和科室间交互；通过强化学习驱动的异构节点稀疏化去除与当前问题无关的智能体，并通过联合优化任务性能与拓扑复杂度的异构边稀疏化保留最具诊断显著性的连接。

ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于面向医疗多模态多智能体协作，动态联合剪枝通信拓扑中的节点和边，以实现自适应协作演化与高效推理。

papers.title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.

ai_summary.problem: 长视频理解需要跨长时间跨度检索信息，现有方法要么依赖查询驱动的探索（对定位错误敏感），要么构建与查询无关的记忆（容易遗漏问题相关的细节），难以兼顾全局上下文与细粒度证据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 VideoTapestry，一个免训练的多智能体框架：先构建三层分层视频记忆（全局叙事、事件级时序结构、细粒度关系证据），为每一层分配专门的智能体，在查询引导下以由粗到细的方式重访相关视频区域并用多模态观察增强各层记忆，最后按原层级组装成查询自适应的复合记忆。
ai_summary.result: 在 LVBench、LongVideoBench (Long)、Video-MME (Long)、EgoSchema 上相比直接使用 GPT-5.5 推理分别取得 17.2%、14.9%、9.8%、7.0% 的绝对准确率提升，并在所有对比方法中达到 SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预构建的分层视频记忆与查询驱动的、逐层分工的多智能体由粗到细精炼机制结合，实现免训练且保留全局上下文与查询相关细粒度证据的自适应记忆。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长视频/多模态理解中的记忆构建与检索提供了新范式，对世界模型与多模态 Agent 的长时程推理具有参考价值。

papers.title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
papers.abstract: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.

ai_summary.problem: 在基于模型的强化学习中，许多方法默认智能体无法从自身经验中恢复控制环境动态的潜在上下文，因此需要外部提供上下文；本文要检验这一假设何时成立。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出“预测充分性”来量化在智能体诱导的访问分布下，额外获得上下文对下一步预测的增益，并将其分解为历史可恢复部分、需要真实上下文的残差部分以及有限模型带来的缺陷；还按条件集所针对的预测风险对上下文感知算法进行分类。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，预测增益并不随MDP类别变化，而取决于先验和智能体行为：某些设置中智能体行为已隐式识别上下文，使外部上下文无显著收益；在仍有增益的场景中，学习到的状态只能部分暴露这些信息，加入真实上下文仍能降低风险。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出一种无需参考策略、仅从普通训练智能体估计的实用准则，用于判断何时需要上下文编码器以及何种上下文机制与可用信息匹配。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于更理性地设计世界模型与上下文编码器，避免在智能体已能隐式识别上下文时引入不必要的外部上下文机制。

papers.title: Video Encoders Built on Image Representations
papers.abstract: The design of a video encoder determines when frames begin to interact and which frame-specific visual evidence remains accessible to the language model. Native video pathways couple neighboring frames during visual encoding, whereas image pathways preserve independently computed frame representations but incur a much larger visual-token cost when all image tokens are forwarded. We ask a basic question: whether a compact video encoder can instead be built on image representations. To answer this question, we separate three operations that are often coupled: per-frame representation, cross-frame token allocation, and temporal interaction. A frozen image encoder first produces frame-specific candidates. A question-aware selector then allocates a fixed token budget across frames using relevance, diversity, and cross-frame correspondence, after which a lightweight learned refiner reads neighboring-frame context and writes residual updates only to the retained anchors. This preserves source positions and keeps the visual output at the fixed budget. Across 13 benchmarks and three vision-language backbones, the resulting pathway matches full-image aggregate performance while using only about 28%-35% of its visual tokens. Specifically, on Qwen3-VL-8B, it achieves a 13-benchmark macro-average of 62.75 with 1,535 visual tokens, compared with 62.58 for the full Image pathway at 4,424 tokens and 59.49 for native Conv3D at 2,212 tokens. On Qwen3-VL-32B, it reaches a 13-benchmark macro-average of 66.28, compared with 66.09 for Image, while providing a 2.16x end-to-end speedup. These results show that compact video encoding does not require early temporal mixing: frame-specific evidence can be preserved first, allocated jointly, and temporally contextualized after selection.

ai_summary.problem: 视频编码器设计中，原生视频路径会在编码早期混合相邻帧，而图像路径虽保留独立的逐帧表示但视觉token开销过大；论文探究能否在图像表示之上构建紧凑的视频编码器。
ai_summary.method: 将常被耦合的三个操作拆开：用冻结的图像编码器生成逐帧候选表示；用问题感知的选择器按相关性、多样性和跨帧对应关系在固定token预算下跨帧分配token；再用轻量可学习的refiner读取邻帧上下文，仅对被保留的锚点写入残差更新，从而保持源位置不变并将视觉输出限制在固定预算内。
ai_summary.result: 在13个基准和三种视觉-语言骨干上，该路径以约28%-35%的视觉token达到与完整图像路径相当的聚合性能；在Qwen3-VL-8B上以1,535个token取得62.75的宏平均，优于完整图像路径（62.58，4,424 token）和原生Conv3D（59.49，2,212 token）；在Qwen3-VL-32B上达66.28并带来2.16倍端到端加速。
ai_summary.novelty: 证明紧凑视频编码无需早期时序混合，而是可以先保留帧级证据、再联合分配token、最后在筛选后进行时序上下文化。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的视频理解提供了一条低token成本、即插即用的编码范式，有望显著降低长视频推理的开销。

papers.title: Lens3D: Target-Conditioned Visual Foveation for Fine-Grained 3D Understanding
papers.abstract: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopts 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench, a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demonstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.

ai_summary.problem: 现有3D大语言模型常忽略细粒度属性和视觉不显著物体/部件，即使场景视频中已包含相关证据。
ai_summary.method: Lens3D通过外部视觉辅助与知识迁移提升细粒度3D理解：LensUnd利用3D定位为外部2D VLM选择信息丰富且互补的视角，完成细粒度物体描述、小物体定位和细粒度问答；LensDistill再用详细描述监督将外部细粒度知识蒸馏到3D LLM，使其无需调用外部VLM即可原生输出细粒度描述。
ai_summary.result: 在Video-3D LLM和3DRS上，LensDistill显著提升细粒度物体描述，同时保持原有定位和场景级问答性能；并构建LensBench，包含2068个物体、每物体3条银标准参考描述。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出目标条件视觉聚焦式的外部VLM辅助与蒸馏框架，将细粒度2D视觉知识迁移到原生3D LLM。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动3D大语言模型的细粒度多模态理解，并验证外部知识向原生3D模型迁移的可行性。

papers.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}

ai_summary.problem: 动作条件化的机器人世界模型需要同时精确响应机器人轨迹并保持真实视觉动态，但从异构机器人视频中同时学到二者十分困难；仿真虽能提供结构化运动监督，却因外观差异难以直接迁移，且仿真预测不准确会误导真实视频生成。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SimForcing 仿真引导框架：一是通过潜空间运动蒸馏，对齐潜空间中的时序变化，从仿真教师模型迁移运动先验并缓解外观差异；二是引入带条件丢弃的多块仿真条件化，以及“仿真条件化无分类器引导”（simulation-conditioning CFG），在内部化运动知识与仿真潜变量引导的预测之间取得平衡。联合训练的学生模型可同时生成仿真条件与真实域视频，推理时无需额外世界模型。
ai_summary.result: 在 Bridge 数据集上，无需外部具身预训练即取得优于对比方法的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 FVD；在 InternData-A1 上的评估也验证了跨机器人数据集的适用性。此外，用该世界模型初始化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可提升 LIBERO 成功率，表明其对下游策略学习有价值。
ai_summary.novelty: 将仿真作为可迁移运动知识源与可控参考，通过潜空间运动蒸馏加仿真条件化无分类器引导，在利用仿真轨迹信息的同时避免过度依赖其预测精度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人世界模型提供了跨仿真—真实域的高效训练范式，并展示了世界模型初始化对 VLA 策略学习的增益，对具身智能与世界模型研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
papers.abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型控制器通常假设动作按计划同步执行，但真实控制系统会因通信延迟、丢包、乱序和执行器缓冲而异步执行，导致动作语义与模型内部假设不一致。
ai_summary.method: 通过受控干预分析异步执行对世界模型控制器的影响，识别出两类架构相关故障模式：TD-MPC2存在想象动作序列与执行动作序列的时间线错配，DreamerV3可能将观测到的状态转移归因于未实际执行的动作。据此提出两种轻量级执行一致性接口：面向TD-MPC2的Future-Sequence和面向DreamerV3的Applied-Action Feedback，无需修改预训练世界模型。
ai_summary.result: 在延迟、丢包、乱序、多个控制域、实测网络轨迹以及进程分离异步栈等实验中，所提诊断和架构特定修正均得到一致支持，有效缓解了异步执行带来的动作语义错配问题。
ai_summary.novelty: 将异步执行从外部控制扰动重新定义为世界模型控制器内部的动作语义错配，并提出与具体架构匹配的轻量级执行一致性接口。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升世界模型与具身智能控制在真实异步通信和 actuator 环境中的鲁棒性与可部署性。

papers.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
papers.abstract: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

ai_summary.problem: 科学图表中的定量数据难以机器读取，而现有基准多基于合成图表或图表类型有限，无法衡量当前模型从真实科研图表中还原数值的准确程度。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PlotGround 自动化流水线：将真实科学图表与其作者公开的源数据（源表格）配对，识别可重建的面板，并生成带源数据参考值的定量问答；据此构建了经人工校验的 PlotGround-1k 基准（来自 1,066 篇 bioRxiv 预印本、共 1,119 道题）。
ai_summary.result: 在 16 个多模态模型中，最佳模型在 ±5% 相对误差容差下准确率为 87.5%，但容差收紧到 ±2% 时所有模型准确率下降 11-24 个百分点；同一数值从源表格而非图表读取时，编码智能体准确率从 90.0% 提升到 97.4%，成本降低 72%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用真实科学图表与其作者源数据配对的方式构建可验证的图表数字化基准，实现图表与源表格的对照评估。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态模型在科学图表定量读取这一能力上提供了真实、可验证的评测标准，揭示了近似视觉阅读与精确数值还原之间的差距。

papers.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
papers.abstract: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

ai_summary.problem: ML论文中的流程图需要在论文栏、幻灯片、海报、社交媒体等多种画布上复用，但每种画布的长宽比不同；本文把“给定栅格流程图与目标长宽比，生成结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的版式”定义为新任务——长宽比自适应流程图重排版。
ai_summary.method: 提出一个分解为 Parse、Style、Layout 三阶段的智能体流水线，每个阶段都由一个主智能体搭配一个 critic，critic 结合确定性约束检查与 VLM 视觉反馈，从而显式校验连接关系、避免连线被静默破坏。最终输出可被 draw.io 编辑的 mxGraph XML。
ai_summary.result: 在包含100个流程图、5种长宽比的精选基准上，由 Gemini 3.1 Pro 评估并经人工判断验证，本方法内容保真度达 68.6%，而现有方法仅为 11.2%–41.4%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将长宽比自适应流程图重排版形式化为独立任务，并用“主智能体+确定性约束与VLM双重critic”的智能体流水线保证结构连通性且输出可编辑矢量格式。
ai_summary.relevance: 为论文配图的自动化、跨画布复用提供了可编辑、防幻觉的智能体式解决方案，展示了多智能体+VLM验证在结构化图形生成与版式重排中的实用价值。

papers.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
papers.abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.

key_lab_papers.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
key_lab_papers.abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

ai_summary.problem: 现有任务无关的JEPA世界模型通常在单一时间尺度或共享潜空间中进行多步预测与规划，难以应对需要跨时间尺度和抽象层级的长时程视觉规划问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出H-JEPA，一种端到端训练动作条件化JEPA层级的方法：每一层在自己的学习潜空间中预测更远的未来。规划采用自顶向下方式，顶层优化向目标的进展，其预测作为下层的子目标。结合逆动力学监督，方法可扩展到DROID真实机器人视频。
ai_summary.result: 在四个模拟导航与操作环境中，层级规划优于扁平JEPA；在Visual AntMaze上，三级层级将成功率从18%提升到73%，且规划计算量更少。在DROID真实机器人视频上，层级结构以更低规划计算量提升了离线规划保真度。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出端到端训练的层级动作条件化JEPA世界模型，通过时间抽象和更高层目标/子目标表示实现跨时间尺度的视觉规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了潜空间世界模型与层级规划的结合，为长时程决策和可扩展机器人学习提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: Meta FAIR / NYU（Yann LeCun等）

key_lab_papers.title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
key_lab_papers.abstract: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.

ai_summary.problem: 长视频理解需要跨长时间跨度检索信息，现有方法要么依赖查询驱动的探索（对定位错误敏感），要么构建与查询无关的记忆（容易遗漏问题相关的细节），难以兼顾全局上下文与细粒度证据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 VideoTapestry，一个免训练的多智能体框架：先构建三层分层视频记忆（全局叙事、事件级时序结构、细粒度关系证据），为每一层分配专门的智能体，在查询引导下以由粗到细的方式重访相关视频区域并用多模态观察增强各层记忆，最后按原层级组装成查询自适应的复合记忆。
ai_summary.result: 在 LVBench、LongVideoBench (Long)、Video-MME (Long)、EgoSchema 上相比直接使用 GPT-5.5 推理分别取得 17.2%、14.9%、9.8%、7.0% 的绝对准确率提升，并在所有对比方法中达到 SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预构建的分层视频记忆与查询驱动的、逐层分工的多智能体由粗到细精炼机制结合，实现免训练且保留全局上下文与查询相关细粒度证据的自适应记忆。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长视频/多模态理解中的记忆构建与检索提供了新范式，对世界模型与多模态 Agent 的长时程推理具有参考价值。
